'''Evvin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] who served during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Evvin was among the contingent of Imperial forces sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in order to combat the [[Dread Host]], the enthralled forces of the rogue [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Evvin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Mission Support Vendor for the Imperial faction in the Section X Daily Area, which was added in Game Update 1.5: HK-51 Activated on [[November 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="TOR" />
